name: vestmap
description: VestMap property data, Offering Memorandum and appraisal market-area tools. Includes the 'vestmap' skill (US property & demographics Q&A via the VestMap MCP server), the 'vestmap-om-pages' skill (renders Offering Memorandum PDF/HTML pages; Block / Tract / ZIP by default, or 1 / 3 / 5-mile radius rings on request) and the 'vestmap-market-area-pages' skill (the Regional and Market Area Analysis, Employment Analysis and data-detail addenda pages of a narrative appraisal report, styled to slot into a USPAP/FIRREA report). All figures and maps come from 2026 Esri GeoEnrichment.
